1 Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/x) from now

Your Tasks
 * Strategic Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor, shaping platform strategy and technical direction for customers.
 * Enterprise-Scale Solutions: Lead the design and execution of highly complex, large-scale platforms.
 * Hands-on Expertise: While primarily strategic, maintain deep technical knowledge and the ability to step in when needed.
 * Infrastructure as Code: Contribute to architecture decisions and review Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar configurations.
 * Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER at conferences, industry events, and within the cloud-native community.
 * Project Delivery: Oversee project execution, ensuring alignment with customer objectives and technical excellence.
 * C-Level Engagement: Consult and present platform strategies to executive leadership.
 * Business Development: Build strong customer relationships, drive platform strategy discussions, and explore new opportunities.

Your Qualifications
 * Consulting Excellence: Extensive experience in platform engineering, DevOps and cloud consulting - with a strong ability to advise clients strategically and technically.
 * Strategical & Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical decision-making, guide architecture discussions, and align engineering direction with business goals.
 * Enterprise Architecture: Deep knowledge of designing and implementing large-scale, resilient platform solutions.
 * Infrastructure & Automation: Strong hands-on technical foundation in platform automation, cloud security, and observability.
 * Leadership & Influence: Ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive innovation, and shape strategic technology decisions.
 * Public Speaking & Thought Leadership: Confident in delivering keynotes, presentations, and engaging with the industry.
 * Business & Technical Alignment: Ability to bridge the gap between technical solutions and business objectives.
 * AI-native: You actively use AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality, or you're eager to start.
 * Communication: Ability to break down complex topics and explain them in a way that makes sense to both engineers and customers.
 * Languages: English and German

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.
 * please refer to the application link for further information

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and 
€ 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Apply here:

jobs.description:
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014, we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 1000 cities in 30+ countries around the world.
We try to make every city we enter a better place - and by that we mean making our customers happy, supporting local businesses, and creating earning opportunities wherever we go. 3 Asc. Operations Manager, Supply Acquisition & Activation (m/w/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central's most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central's ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you'll be doing

 * Own Central's intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

 * Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

 * Own Central's courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

 * Own and report on Central's UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

 * Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

 * Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

 * Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central's supply health.

Our humble expectations

 * Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

 * Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

 * Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

 * Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

 * Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 * Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

 * Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing. 

The salary below is the gross monthly salary range for this position. 

€6.503-€8.129 EUR

APPLY NOW!
